import json, math
cases=[]
def seg(a,b,c='#16866a',w=3): return dict(from_=a,to=b,color=c,width=w)
def S(a,b,c='#16866a',w=3): return {'from':a,'to':b,'color':c,'width':w}
def ok(name,source,segments=None,mode='2d'):
 cases.append(dict(name=name,mode=mode,source=source,expect={'segments':segments or []}))
def err(name,source,line,column=None,segments=None,mode='2d',parse=True):
 e={'line':line}
 if column is not None:e['column']=column
 ex={'error':e}
 if parse:ex['segments']=[]
 elif segments is not None:ex['segments']=segments
 cases.append(dict(name=name,mode=mode,source=source,expect=ex))
def path(points,c='#16866a',w=3):return [S(a,b,c,w) for a,b in zip(points,points[1:])]
O=[0,0,0]
ok('empty program','')
ok('comments hide commands and delimiters','; np 99 [ oto bad\\nnp 2 ; unknown ] \"bad\"\\n; end', [S(O,[0,2,0])])
for label,aliases,sign in [('forward','np naprzod naprzód fd forward',1),('backward','ws wstecz bk back',-1)]:
 for alias in aliases.split():ok('movement alias '+alias,alias+' 2',[S(O,[0,2*sign,0])])
for label,aliases,sign in [('right','pw prawo rt right',1),('left','lw lewo lt left',-1)]:
 ok(label+' aliases', '\\n'.join(a+' 90 np 1' for a in aliases.split()),path([O,[sign,0,0],[sign,-1,0],[0,-1,0],O]))
for a in 'pod podnies podnieś pu penup'.split():ok('pen up alias '+a,a+' np 7')
for a in 'opu opusc opuść pd pendown'.split():ok('pen down alias '+a,'pu np 2 '+a+' np 3',[S([0,2,0],[0,5,0])])
ok('signed and fractional distances','np +3 np -12.5 ws -.5 fd .5',path([O,[0,3,0],[0,-9.5,0],[0,-9,0],[0,-8.5,0]]))
ok('zero moves do not draw','np 0 ws -0 fd +0 bk 0.0 np 1',[S(O,[0,1,0])])
ok('negative and full circle turns','pw -90 np 2 lw -180 np 1 rt 720 fd 1',path([O,[-2,0,0],[-1,0,0],O]))
ok('nonexact angle coordinates','rt 30 fd 2 lt 75 fd 2',path([O,[1,1.732050808,0],[-0.414213562,3.146264370,0]]))
ok('fractional angles','right +22.5 forward 4 left -22.5 back 2',path([O,[1.530733729,3.695518130,0],[0.116520167,2.281304567,0]]))
ok('pen state persists and repeated toggles are harmless','pu pu fd 2 rt 90 fd 3 pd pd fd 1 pu fd 1 pd bk 2', [S([3,2,0],[4,2,0]),S([5,2,0],[3,2,0])])
ok('both colour aliases and lowercase output','np 1 kolor \"#Ab09Ff\" np 1 color \"#000000\" np 1', [S(O,[0,1,0]),S([0,1,0],[0,2,0],'#ab09ff'),S([0,2,0],[0,3,0],'#000000')])
ok('all width aliases and endpoints','grubosc 1 np 1 grubość 12 np 1 width 4 np 1', [S(O,[0,1,0],w=1),S([0,1,0],[0,2,0],w=12),S([0,2,0],[0,3,0],w=4)])
ok('style changes while pen is raised persist','pu color \"#FF0000\" width 2 fd 2 pd fd 3 fd 1',path([[0,2,0],[0,5,0],[0,6,0]],'#ff0000',2))
ok('uppercase accented keywords','PoDnIeŚ NaPrZÓd 2 OpUŚĆ GrUbOŚĆ 5 KoLoR \"#ABCDEF\" NP 1',[S([0,2,0],[0,3,0],'#abcdef',5)])
for a in 'powtorz powtórz repeat'.split():ok('repeat alias '+a,a+' 2 [np 1 pw 90]',path([O,[0,1,0],[1,1,0]]))
ok('repeat zero has no state effects','repeat 0 [fd 99 rt 90 pu color \"#ffffff\" width 12] fd 1',[S(O,[0,1,0])])
ok('nested repeats preserve state','repeat 2 [repeat 2 [fd 1] rt 90]',path([O,[0,1,0],[0,2,0],[1,2,0],[2,2,0]]))
ok('empty repeat body','repeat 3 [] fd 1',[S(O,[0,1,0])])
ok('brackets need no surrounding spaces','repeat 2[fd 1]',path([O,[0,1,0],[0,2,0]]))
ok('newlines and tabs separate ordinary arguments','fd\\n\\t2 rt\\n90\\nfd\\t1',path([O,[0,2,0],[1,2,0]]))
ok('ma parameters with accented case insensitive references','oto Krok ma: Długość, Kąt\\nNP długość PW :KĄT np :DŁUGOŚĆ\\njuż\\nkRoK 2 90',path([O,[0,2,0],[2,2,0]]))
ok('legacy header and mixed reference forms','to krok :d :a\\nfd :d rt a bk d\\nend\\nkrok 3 90',path([O,[0,3,0],[-3,3,0]]))
ok('forward procedure reference and unaccented ending','ruch 2\\noto ruch ma: n\\nnp n\\njuz',[S(O,[0,2,0])])
ok('zero parameter procedure and multiple calls','to tick\\nfd 1\\nend\\ntick tick',path([O,[0,1,0],[0,2,0]]))
ok('parameters used for repeat width and nested call','oto outer ma: n, d, w\\nwidth w repeat n [inner d]\\njuż\\noto inner ma: distance\\nfd distance\\nend\\nouter 2 3 6',path([O,[0,3,0],[0,6,0]],w=6))
ok('procedure parameters restore caller scope','to inner ma: x\\nfd x\\nend\\nto outer ma: x\\ninner 2 fd x\\nend\\nouter 5',path([O,[0,2,0],[0,7,0]]))
ok('procedure state changes persist after return','to setup\\nrt 90 color \"#123abc\" width 7 pu fd 2 pd\\nend\\nsetup fd 3',[S([2,0,0],[5,0,0],'#123abc',7)])
ok('definition header and ending permit comments','oto p ma: x ; header\\n np x ; body\\njuż ; ending\\np 2',[S(O,[0,2,0])])
for a in 'gora góra pitchup dol dół pitchdown'.split():
 sign=1 if a in ['gora','góra','pitchup'] else -1
 ok('3D pitch alias '+a,a+' 90 fd 2',[S(O,[0,0,2*sign])],mode='3d')
ok('pitch then turn uses moving local up','pitchup 90 rt 90 fd 2 pitchup 90 fd 3',path([O,[2,0,0],[2,-3,0]]),mode='3d')
ok('turn then pitch and backward movement','rt 90 pitchup 90 fd 2 pitchdown 90 bk 3',path([O,[0,0,2],[-3,0,2]]),mode='3d')
ok('negative fractional pitch','pitchup -30 fd 2 pitchdown -60 fd 2',path([O,[0,1.732050808,-1],[0,3.464101615,0]]),mode='3d')
flat='repeat 4 [fd 2 rt 90] pu bk 1 pd lt 90 fd 3'
flatsegments=path([O,[0,2,0],[2,2,0],[2,0,0],O])+[S([0,-1,0],[-3,-1,0])]
for mode in ['2d','3d']:ok('flat geometry in '+mode,flat,flatsegments,mode)
# Invalid programs have a valid stroke first, to verify whole-program validation.
err('unknown command prevents all drawing','np 1\\n  mystery',2,3)
err('missing numeric argument','np 1\\nfd',2)
err('non numeric movement argument','np 1\\nfd nope',2,4)
for token in ['1+2','1e2','NaN','Infinity','0x10']:
 err('invalid number '+token,'np 1\\nfd '+token,2,4)
for token in ['\"#12345\"','\"#1234567\"','\"#12gg34\"','#123456']:
 err('invalid colour '+token,'np 1\\ncolor '+token,2,7)
err('missing colour','np 1\\ncolor',2)
for token in ['0','13','1.5','-1']:
 err('invalid width '+token,'np 1\\nwidth '+token,2,7)
for token in ['-1','10001','2.5']:
 err('invalid repeat count '+token,'np 1\\nrepeat '+token+' [fd 1]',2,8)
err('repeat missing opening bracket','np 1\\nrepeat 2 fd 1',2,10)
err('unexpected closing bracket','np 1\\n]',2,1)
err('unclosed bracket','repeat 2 [fd 1',1)
err('zero repeat body still validated','np 1\\nrepeat 0 [unknown]',2,11)
err('unused procedure still validated','np 1\\nto unused\\n  unknown\\nend',3,3)
for a in ['gora','góra','pitchup','dol','dół','pitchdown']:
 err('2D rejects '+a,'np 1\\n'+a+' 90',2,1)
err('2D rejects pitch in zero repeat','np 1\\nrepeat 0 [pitchup 90]',2,11)
err('undefined numeric parameter','np 1\\nto p\\nfd missing\\nend\\np',3,4)
err('parameters are not globals','to p ma: n\\nfd n\\nend\\np 2\\nfd n',5,4)
err('too few procedure arguments','to p ma: a, b\\nfd a fd b\\nend\\np 1',4)
err('too many procedure arguments','to p ma: a\\nfd a\\nend\\np 1 2',4)
err('duplicate case insensitive procedure definition','to p\\nend\\nto P\\nend',3)
err('definition inside repeat','repeat 1 [\\nto p\\nend\\n]',2)
err('definition inside procedure','to outer\\nto inner\\nend\\nend',2)
err('missing procedure ending','to p\\nfd 1',2)
err('direct recursion even in zero repeat','to p\\nrepeat 0 [p]\\nend',2)
err('indirect recursion even when unused','to a\\nb\\nend\\nto b\\na\\nend',5)
# Limits: put all possible offending tokens on one line when the exact cutoff is unspecified.
ok('source character limit is inclusive',';'+'x'*49999)
err('source character limit exceeded',';'+'x'*50000,1)
ok('token limit is inclusive','pu '*10000)
err('token limit exceeded','pu '*10001,1)
ok('bracket and repeat depth 32 accepted','repeat 1 ['*32+'fd 1'+']'*32,[S(O,[0,1,0])])
err('bracket depth 33 rejected','repeat 1 ['*33+'fd 1'+']'*33,1)
err('active frames include calls and repeats','to p\\n'+'repeat 1 ['*32+'pu'+']'*32+'\\nend\\np',2,parse=False)
err('executed operation limit with no segments','repeat 10000 [repeat 2 [pu]]',1,segments=[],parse=False)
err('drawing beyond operation and segment budgets','repeat 10000 [fd 1] fd 1',1,parse=False)
ok('coordinate bounds inclusive both signs','fd 100000 bk 200000',path([O,[0,100000,0],[0,-100000,0]]))
err('positive coordinate limit preserves earlier segments','fd 100000\\nfd 1',2,segments=[S(O,[0,100000,0])],parse=False)
err('pen up moves also obey coordinate bounds','fd 1\\npu bk 100002',2,segments=[S(O,[0,1,0])],parse=False)
err('3D z coordinate limit','pitchup 90 fd 100000\\nfd 1',2,segments=[S(O,[0,0,100000])],mode='3d',parse=False)
with open('/work/cases.json','w') as f:json.dump({'version':1,'cases':cases},f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\\n')
print(len(cases),'cases')
